a: अभिताम्र — a. Very red, darkred; R. 15. 49.

agitation, affliction, emotion
great pain.
a: अभितापः — Extreme heat, whether of body or mind; agitation, affliction, great distress or pain; Śi. 9. 1; Ki. 9. 4; बलवान्पुनर्मे मनसोभितापः V. 3.

m: अभि-तापिन् mfn. intensely hot, Dharmaś.
अभि-ताडन n. striking, a stroke, Śiś.
अभि-ताडित mfn. knocked, struck.
अभि-√ तॄ to come near, approach (Ā. 3. du. -तरेते), RV. i, 140, 3; to overtake, get up to, MBh. vii, 280.

m: अभितः-सर mfn. running on both sides, Up.
अभि-√ तंस् (perf. 3. pl. -ततस्रे), to shake out of, rob, RV. iv, 50, 2 and x, 89, 15.
अभितश्-चर m. pl. the attendants, retinue, MBh. &c.

अभि-√ तन् to stretch or spread across or over, be prominent, (aor. 1. pl. -ततनाम), RV. i, 160, 5 and v, 54, 15; to extend or enlarge in front of (perf. Ā. 2. sg. -तत्निषे), RV. viii, 6, 25 and ix, 108, 6.
अभि-√ तप् to irradiate with heat, to heat, AV. &c.; to pain, distress: Pass. -तप्यते, to suffer intensely: Caus. -तापयति, to distress.
a: अभितप् — {c1c} P. 1 To irradiate with heat, heat, inflame; अभितप्तमयोपि मार्दवं भजते कैव कथा शरीरिषु R. 8. 43; 19. 56. --2 To pain, distress, wound, afflict. --pass. To suffer intensely, be afflicted. --Caus. To pain, distress, afflict.

m: अभि-तप्त mfn. scorched, burnt
afflicted about (acc.), R.
a: अभितप्त — p. p. 1 Heated, inflamed, scorched, burnt. --2 Distressed, grieving or lamenting for (actively used).

m: अभि-√ तड् -ताडयति, to thump, hit, beat, wound, bruise; (in astron.) to eclipse the greater part of a disk, VarBṛS.
a: अभितड् — {c10c} P. 1 To beat, knock, thump, hit, smite, strike (fig. also); to wound; वाक्शरैरभिताडितः Rām. --2 (Astr.) To eclipse the greater part of the disc; Bṛ. S. 11. 61.

अभि-तरम् &c. See अभि.
अभि-√ तर्ज् -तर्जयति, to scold, abuse.

m: अभि-तस् ind. near to, towards, MBh. &c.
near, in the proximity or presence of (gen.), Bhag. &c.
(with acc.) on both sides, ŚBr. &c.
(with acc.) before and after, ĀśvŚr.; KātyŚr.; Gaut.
(with acc.) on all sides, everywhere, about, round
entirely, MBh.
quickly, L.
अभि-तस् ind. See अभि.
a: अभितस् — ind. (Used as an adverb, or preposition with acc.) 1 Near to, to, towards; अभितस्तं पृथासूनुः स्नेहेन परितस्तरे Ki. 11. 8. --2 (a) Near, hard by, close by, in the proximity of; ततो राजाब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुमंत्रमभितः स्थितं Rām; sometimes with gen.; निषसादाभितस्तस्य ibid. (b) Before, in the presence of; तन्वंतमिद्धमभितो गुरुमंशुजालं Ki. 2. 59. --3 Opposite to, facing, in front of; त्रिपथगामभितः Ki. 6. 1, 5. 14. --4 On both sides; चूडाचुंबितकंकपत्रमभितस्तूणीद्वयं पृष्ठतः U. 4. 20; Mv. 1. 18; पादपैः पुष्पपत्राणि सृजद्भिरभितो नदीं Rām; Ś. 6. 16; Bk. 9. 137. --5 Before and after. --6 On all sides, round, round about (with acc. or gen.); कीर्त्याभितः सुरभितः Dk. 1; परिजनो यथाव्यापारं राजानमभितः स्थितः M. 1; Ś. 7; यस्याभितः U. 6. 36; everywhere Ki. 8. 10. --7 Entirely, thoroughly, completely, throughout. --8 Quickly. --Comp. --अस्थि a. surrounded by bones. --भाविन् a. being all round, surrounding P. VI. 2. 182. --रात्रं Ved. near the night; just at the beginning or end.

m: अभि-तष्टीय n. N. of the hymn, RV. iii, 38 (beginning अभि तष्तेव), ŚāṅkhŚr.

अभि-√ तृद् -तृणत्ति (Imper. 2. sg. -तृन्धि [for तृन्द्-धि]; aor. Subj. 2. sg. -तर्दस्, RV. vi, 17, 1) to burst open, open, procure (waters) by bursting (the clouds) or by boring (i.e. digging a well), RV. &c.; to procure (वाजम्, वाजान्, गाः, गन्धर्वम्), RV.; अन्नाद्यम्, &c., ŚBr. &c.: Desid. (Subj. 3. pl. -तितृत्सान्) to try to open, RV. x, 74, 4.
अभि-√ तृप् Caus. -तर्पयति (pr. p. f. pl. -तर्पयन्तीः, AV.) to satiate, refresh.
a: अभितृप् — {c10c} P. 1 To satiate, satisfy. --2 To refresh; Bṛ. S. 19. 15.

m: अभि-तृप्त mfn. satiated, refreshed.
अभि-तृत्ति f. the act of procuring or gaining, Kāṭh.
अभि-तिग्मरश्मि ind. towards the sun, Śiś. ix, 11.
अभितो (in Sandhi for अभितस्).
अभितो—भाविन् mfn. being on both, sides, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 182.
अभितो—देव-यजन-मात्र-देश mfn. whose space on all sides suffices for a sacrificial ground, KātyŚr.
अभितो—रात्रम् ind. near (i.e. either just at the beginning or end of) the night, ŚBr.
अभितो—ऽस्थि (अभितो-), mfn. surrounded by bones (as the eyes), ŚBr.
अभि-त्रास m. putting in fear, intimidating, Āp.
अभि-त्रिपिष्टप mfn. being over the three worlds, Hariv.
अभि-त्सार m. catching, entrapping, MaitrS.; Kāṭh.
अभि-√ त्सर् (3. pl. -त्सरन्ति) to catch, entrap, RV. viii, 2, 6.
अ-भित्ति f. not bursting, VS. xi, 64
no wall, Kathās.
अ-भित्ति mfn. having no walls i.e. no solid foundation, Śiś. iv, 53.
अभि-√ तुष् -तुष्यति, to be glad or pleased, Kathās.
अभि-√ त्वर् to be in haste.
अभि-√ त्यज् to abandon, R. ii, 47, 5 (ed. Bomb.)
